title: Task-Preserving Multilingual Instruction Tuning for Open-Ended QA in WMT 2026 MIST
abstract: arXiv:2610.29926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper describes our submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. We adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA using organiser-provided data, EuroAlpaca, a multilingual instruction dataset created through task-preserving localisation, and CrossEuroAlpaca, a cross-lingual augmentation that assigns different source and target languages to instructions, contexts and responses. Our system targets open-ended question answering (QA-OEG) in ten shared-task languages represented in the auxiliary data. Under matched decoding, adaptation improves the mean Gemma-4 judge score on target-language QA-OEG by 7.8% relative to the base model. On an additional evaluation using the Aya Evaluation Suite across all shared-task languages, it yields relative gains of 41.5% in macro-averaged ROUGE-L and 2.9% in BERTScore-F1, with larger improvements in target languages. However, these gains are task- and language-specific. Gemma-4 scores improve for QA-O

translated_title: WMT 2026 MIST中面向开放式问答的任务保持型多语言指令微调
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了我们提交给WMT 2026多语言指令共享任务（Multilingual Instruction Shared Task）的方案。我们使用LoRA对Qwen3-8B进行适配，所使用的数据包括：主办方提供的数据、EuroAlpaca（一个通过任务保持型本地化方式构建的多语言指令数据集），以及CrossEuroAlpaca（一种跨语言增强数据集，它为指令、上下文和回答分配不同的源语言与目标语言）。我们的系统针对十个共享任务语言的开放式问答生成任务（QA-OEG），这些语言均在辅助数据中有所体现。在匹配解码条件下，与基础模型相比，适配使目标语言QA-OEG的平均Gemma-4评审分数相对提升了7.8%。在基于Aya评估套件对所有共享任务语言进行的额外评估中，该方案在宏观平均ROUGE-L上取得了41.5%的相对提升，在BERTScore-F1上取得了2.9%的相对提升，且目标语言上的改进幅度更大。然而，这些提升是特定于任务和语言的。Gemma-4分数在QA-O（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过LoRA结合任务保持型本地化构建的多语言指令数据集（EuroAlpaca）及其跨语言增强版本（CrossEuroAlpaca）对Qwen3-8B进行微调，在WMT 2026 MIST共享任务的十种语言开放式问答任务上显著提升了性能，但这些提升具有任务和语言特异性。
en_tdlr: The study fine-tunes Qwen3-8B with LoRA using EuroAlpaca, a task-preserving localized multilingual instruction dataset, and its cross-lingual augmentation CrossEuroAlpaca, achieving significant performance gains on open-ended QA across ten languages in the WMT 2026 MIST shared task, though these gains are task- and language-specific.
